nodes.text: A cinematic, Dutch angle night shot of a retro hotel entrance illuminated by neon cyan and warm orange lights. A bellhop in uniform pulls a gold luggage cart with suitcases across a wet sidewalk. Inside the brightly lit, teal-toned glass lobby, two women in vintage uniforms stand near a wooden desk alongside tropical plants and a seated figure. The scene features a moody, stylized teal-and-orange color palette with strong neon reflections. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
